supportedConclusions: Frozen fixture uses Wasm-generated application control flow and schema validation with checked storage metadata.
All tested failing transactions roll back, including faults after first successful write.
Runtime instance and host authority scope preserve fixture principal separation.
Inconclusive route decision and provisional Rust full-slice selection are proportionate to current evidence.
limitations: No production/backend adoption approval or whole-language proof.
Full-slice per-request transaction executes synchronous storage resumptions; only outer request/RPC is asynchronous.
Throughput readonly I/O intentionally bypasses trace-heavy full host transaction wrapper for both-target scope alignment; benchmark is not full transaction throughput.
RSS includes both target support and latency samples in one Bun process; it is not per-target isolated memory.
No performance winner inferred; uncontrolled workstation load and per-request Wasm instantiation remain explicit.
A17/A18 separately linked evidence and actual cloud/log/header evidence are coordinator gates, not independently certified by this review.
